## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the release gate before merge because it blocks releases that meet the configured approval minimum.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates the deployment catalog with production service names and ports. It also changes the service health predicate and the release approval comparison.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases at the approval minimum — `approved(2)` returns `False` with the default minimum of two. The new `>` comparison excludes equality even though the gate requires “at least the configured number of approvals.” — Releases with exactly the required number of approvals remain blocked until someone adds an extra approval. — Fix: Restore `>=` and extend `test_approved_release`.

## Important
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the non-service entry from the catalog — Reading `entry["port"]` for each catalog record raises `TypeError` at `review_note`. Its value is a string, while every service record is an object with `port` and `enabled` fields. — Deployment tooling that loads the catalog as a map of service records cannot finish loading it.
